# Template Library

Reusable starter templates for llm-wiki pages and adjacent notes.

The authoritative field schema remains `docs/runtime-page-templates.en.md`.
These files are practical copy/edit templates for humans and skills. Keep
template placeholders in `{{double_braces}}`, preserve wikilinks as
`[[slug]]`, and use `YYYY-MM-DD` where a date should be filled at creation
time.

## Core Wiki Page Templates

- `paper-template.md` -> `wiki/papers/{slug}.md`
- `concept-template.md` -> `wiki/concepts/{slug}.md`
- `topic-template.md` -> `wiki/topics/{slug}.md`
- `person-template.md` -> `wiki/people/{slug}.md`
- `idea-template.md` -> `wiki/ideas/{slug}.md`
- `experiment-template.md` -> `wiki/experiments/{slug}.md`
- `claim-template.md` -> `wiki/claims/{slug}.md`
- `summary-template.md` -> `wiki/Summary/{slug}.md`
- `foundation-template.md` -> `wiki/foundations/{slug}.md`

## Adjacent Templates

- `source-template.md` -> manual notes/web source records
- `synthesis-template.md` -> higher-level synthesis notes or outputs
- `personal-writing-template.md` -> drafts and personal argument notes
- `entity-template.md` -> generic non-person entity notes when needed

Converted paper source markdown under `wiki/sources/papers/` is generated by
MinerU and should not be hand-authored from these templates.
